actionType.description:
The type of the action. This identifies it so it can be consumed by
{@link Ann.UiSdlReducer} and {@link Ann.UiSdlEpic}.
NOTE: The real field name is `type` but it is reserved

payload.description:
The data to be sent as payload. Consumers of this action
can use this as parameters.

error.description: If true, it means this action contains error information

title:
A {@link UiSdlReduxAction} indicating that the web application encountered a chunk loading error
when trying to load additional JavaScript code, CSS, or other UI resources at runtime. This may
occur under a variety of scenarios, including:
- The user logged out or their session expired.
- The UI resources are no longer available on the server.
name: UiSdlChunkLoadingErrorAction
